classification_policy: Official website or authoritative regulator evidence only; unresolved records are manual_review.

records.name: Hamidia Girls Degree College
records.statutory_basis: Constituent minority degree college of the University of Allahabad
records.evidence: The official college site identifies Hamidia Girls Degree College as a constituent minority college of the University of Allahabad offering arts and commerce degree programmes. It is therefore classified as a constituent government degree college in the central-university system.

records.name: Handia P.G. College, Handia, Allahabad
records.evidence: The official college site presents Handia P.G. College as an affiliated postgraduate degree college in Prayagraj under Prof. Rajendra Singh (Rajju Bhaiya) University. The legacy record identifies it as a government college; it is classified in the government degree-college family with aided ownership.
notes: Confirm aided-versus-state-government funding from the Uttar Pradesh higher-education directory before any database import.

records.name: IFTM University
records.statutory_basis: University established under the IFTM University Act, 2010, as a state private university
records.evidence: The official IFTM University site describes the Moradabad institution as a multidisciplinary university established under the IFTM University Act, 2010. It is a private university rather than a state-government university.

records.name: KHWAJA MOINUDDIN CHISHTI URDU ARABI FARSI UNIVERSITY
records.statutory_basis: University established by Uttar Pradesh state legislation
records.evidence: The official university site identifies Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Language University, Lucknow as a Uttar Pradesh state public university offering multidisciplinary and multilingual programmes.

records.name: Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology
records.statutory_basis: Government of Uttar Pradesh technical university established under state legislation
records.evidence: The official site identifies Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology as a Government of Uttar Pradesh teaching and research university in Gorakhpur with engineering and technology programmes.

records.name: Maharishi University of Information Technology
records.statutory_basis: Uttar Pradesh state private university established under the Maharishi University of Information Technology Act
records.evidence: The official MUIT site presents Maharishi University of Information Technology as a university with undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma and doctoral programmes in Uttar Pradesh. It is a private university, not a state-government university.

records.name: Prof. Rajendra Singh (Rajju Bhaiya) University, Prayagraj
records.statutory_basis: Uttar Pradesh state university established under state legislation in 2016
records.evidence: The official university site identifies Prof. Rajendra Singh (Rajju Bhaiya) University as a state university in Prayagraj offering undergraduate, postgraduate, professional and doctoral programmes.

records.name: Sanskriti University
records.statutory_basis: Uttar Pradesh state private university established in 2016
records.evidence: The official Sanskriti University site presents the Mathura institution as a private university offering undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, certificate and doctoral programmes.

records.name: Shiv Nadar University
records.statutory_basis: Private multidisciplinary university in Gautam Buddha Nagar established under Uttar Pradesh state law
records.evidence: The official Shiv Nadar University site identifies its Delhi-NCR campus in Gautam Buddha Nagar as a multidisciplinary research-led university with undergraduate, graduate and doctoral admissions.

records.name: Shobhit-University
records.statutory_basis: Private deemed-to-be university under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956
records.evidence: The official site identifies Shobhit Institute of Engineering & Technology, popularly known as Shobhit University, as a deemed-to-be university at Meerut. Its private deemed status maps to the private deemed-university group.
